paite: Huchi in siampu lianpen Joshua TOUPA angel ma a dingh leh Setan akhut taklam a ahek ding a dingh ahon musak hi.
heading: Siampu lian Joshua Hiang Chiamtehna
english: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before Yahweh’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Aw Setan, TOUPA'N hon tai hen; ahi, Jerusalem telpa TOUPA'N nang hon tai hen; hiai mi kangmei a kipan sahkhiak ahi kei a hia?" achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Yahweh rebuke you, Satan! Yes, Yahweh who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”

paite: Huchi in Joshua puansilh nin a kizem in angel ma ah adingh hi.
english: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

paite: Angel in ama a dinghte kiang ah thu agenta hi. "Amah a kipan puansilh nin lamang un,” chi in. Huan akiang ah, "Ngai in, na thulimlouhna nang a kipan ka lakheta a, puansilh hoih in ka hon zem ding," chi in.
english: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Aluzang ah lukhu siang koih uhen," ka chi a. Huchi in aluzang ah lukhu siang akoih ua, puansilh in atuam ua; huchi in TOUPA angel kiangnai ah adingh hi.
english: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and Yahweh’s angel was standing by.

paite: Huan TOUPA angel in Joshua kiang ah hiai thu agen a,
english: Yahweh’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,

paite: "Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ka lampite a na om a, ka thupiak na zuihleh ka inko vai na hawm ding a, ka vaihawmna innte ah thu na nei dia, hiai a dinghte lak a luttheihna ka hon pe ding," chi in.
english: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.

paite: Aw siampu lianpen Joshua, tu in za un; nang leh na ma a tu na lawite; amau chiamtehna hoih mite ahi ua; ngai in ka sikha Hiang hon pi ding ka hih ziak in.
english: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.

paite: Ngai in, Joshua ma a ka suang koih, suang khat mit sagih nei tung ah laigelh ka gelh ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Ni khat thu in gam pumpi thulimlouhna ka lamang ding hi, chi in.
english: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in, na grepgui nuai leh theipi sing nuai ah michih in a-invengte na chial ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: In that day,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”
